fields.name: call
fields.description: The Lua function name that will be triggered to do filtering.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Inline Lua code instead of loading from a path defined in script.

fields.name: enable_flb_null
fields.description: If enabled, null will be converted to flb_null in Lua.

fields.name: protected_mode
fields.description: If enabled, the Lua script will be executed in protected mode.

fields.name: script
fields.description: Path to the Lua script that will be used.

fields.name: time_as_table
fields.description: By default, when the Lua script is invoked, the record timestamp is passed as a floating number, which might lead to precision loss when it's converted back.

fields.name: type_array_key
fields.description: If these keys are matched, the fields are handled as array.

fields.name: type_int_key
fields.description: If these keys are matched, the fields are converted to integers.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
